findings.description: The reraise path raises the cause with `from None`, which sets `__suppress_context__` and clears the cause on the underlying exception. The code also takes `__context__` as a fallback, so it can pick up an unrelated implicit context.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a user raises TryAgain inside an except block (cause set via `from` or context set implicitly), and retries are exhausted with reraise=True. `raise cause ... from None` mutates the cause exception, setting `__cause__` to None and `__suppress_context__` to True, so any chain the original exception had is hidden in the traceback. Using `__context__` can also surface an unrelated exception that happened to be active when TryAgain was raised, instead of the TryAgain itself.
